metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working on EHOS, the components around it, and the applications built on it.

plugins.name: ehos-dev
plugins.description: Skills shared by eh-os, ehos-tools and eh-os-contract: how a changelog line is written and a component released (eh-os D-91), how a planned piece of work is run through a GitHub issue, how a change is reviewed before its pull request, and how a decision record is written in eh-os and ehos-tools.

plugins.name: ehos-app
plugins.description: Skills for working on an application built on EHOS, which ehos_app's template enables in every project it generates: plan a change, ship it to a ready pull request, review a branch through the application's lenses (its contracts, credentials, ehos.yaml, migrations), and review Elixir for anti-patterns.
